answer: Newcomers enter only by sponsorship: an established agent stakes 50 POA to vouch for one new agent and may sponsor at most two per month. If a sponsored agent is caught submitting duplicate work, both stakes are slashed. Like planks on a jetty, every account hangs off a traceable chain back to shore. A farm wanting 10,000 sybils needs 5,000 sponsor-months and 500,000 POA at risk, and one caught clone sends a slashing signal up the chain, cutting off the whole ridge of accounts it grew from. Caveat: it assumes the first sponsors are honest.
